title: Introducing Microsoft 365 Copilot with Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, and OneNote
summary: Microsoft's March 2023 launch highlights for Microsoft 365 Copilot, showing AI features in Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel and OneNote. The demo includes using it to draft a graduation party speech.
why: Mostly cited critically, as an example of AI being used for personal moments in ways commenters found dystopian.
